question: Every engine other than Voxtral at what a 16GB Mac loads by default, over the 20-file corpus on the M4 16GB, 3 runs each
note: M4 16GB (Mac16,1) on AC power, one arm at a time; before each arm the queue waited for GPU memory in use under 1GB and GPU utilisation under 10%. Each engine at what this Mac loads by default (variants.select on its 12.7GB working set), with the same runner commands as the M2 Ultra headline rows; voxtral-v1 8bit was quantized and the reazon weights downloaded before the first arm, so no arm includes them. whisper_turbo_nocond_r2 started with CPU load 5.38 (flagged busy) while the GPU was free; its per-file median speed matches r1 (ratio 0.99), and its lower mean comes from two files where sampling produced 2-4x more segments, as in whisper_large-v3_nocond_r3 (per-file median ratio 1.01). Whisper samples, so speed varies between runs; the mean of the 3 runs is the figure.

caveats: other GPU work at start: load 5.38 over 10 cpus
